description: Three channels of noise built from a 32-bit seed, each with looping random shapes driving its level, filter cutoff and resonance, mixed to a stereo pair

params.text: Sets how fast the random shapes run, in nine steps from a hundredth of their built-in rate to eight times it

inputs.text: A rising edge here picks a new random seed, and the noise fades out and back in on the new one

outputs.text: The left side of the noise, the first and second channels summed
The right side of the noise, the first and third channels summed

notes: the seed is set with the grid of 32 buttons, each one a bit of the seed, and the Random button rolls a new one
a new module picks a random seed for itself and sounds as soon as it is added; nothing has to be patched to it

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
